examples.chinese: 這些是中文書，那些是英文書。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì Zhōngwén shū, nàxiē shì Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: These are books in Chinese; those are in English.

examples.chinese: 這些是中文書，那些是英文書。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shì Zhōngwén shū, nàxiē shì Yīngwén shū.
examples.english: These are books in Chinese; those are in English.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共兩萬三千五百零五塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng liǎng wàn sān qiān wǔ bǎi líng wǔ kuài.
examples.english: These stuff cost twenty three thousand, five hundred and five dollars in total.

examples.chinese: 這些水果，有的不甜，我不想吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ, yǒude bù tián, wǒ bù xiǎng chī.
examples.english: Some of this fruit are not sweet, I do not want to eat them.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 這些中文句子不難，我都懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōngwén jùzi bù nán, wǒ dōu dǒng.
examples.english: These Chinese sentences are not difficult; I understand them all.

examples.chinese: A:這些相片是在哪裡照的？ B:花蓮。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē xiàngpiàn shì zài nǎlǐ zhào de? B: Huālián.
examples.english: A: Where were these photos taken? B: Hualien.

examples.chinese: A:這些點心夠不夠？ B:夠了，夠了，我們已經吃過午飯了。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē diǎnxin gòu bu gòu? B: Gòu le, gòu le, wǒmen yǐjīng chī guo wǔfàn le.
examples.english: A: Are these snacks enough? B: Enough, enough; we have already eaten lunch.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 小張喜歡閱讀法國的文學作品，透過這些作品，讓他了解了法國文化的特色。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng xǐhuan yuèdú Fǎguó de wénxué zuòpǐn, tòuguò zhèxiē zuòpǐn, ràng tā liǎojiě le Fǎguó wénhuà de tèsè.
examples.english: Xiao Zhang likes to read French literary works; through these works, he has come to understand the characteristics of French culture.

examples.chinese: 可是這些時間我都有語言交換，不能去。
examples.pinyin: Kěshì zhèxiē shíjiān wǒ dōu yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, bù néng qù.
examples.english: But I will be doing language exchange during that time. I can’t make it.

examples.chinese: 外國人覺得台灣人很好，迷路時，都會有人告訴他們怎麼走。
examples.pinyin: Wàiguórén juéde Táiwānrén hěn hǎo, mílù shí, dōu huì yǒu rén gàosu tāmen zěnme zǒu.
examples.english: Foreigners feel that Taiwanese people are very nice; when they get lost, there is always someone to tell them how to go.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的路規劃得不太理想，不僅沒有一條是直的，方向也有點兒亂，很容易就迷路了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū de lù guīhuà de bú tài lǐxiǎng, bùjǐn méiyǒu yì tiáo shì zhí de, fāngxiàng yě yǒudiǎnr luàn, hěn róngyì jiù mílù le.
examples.english: The roads in this area are not planned very ideally; not only is there not a single straight one, but the directions are also a bit chaotic, so it's easy to get lost.

examples.chinese: 他在山裡迷路了，只好順著河流往山下走。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài shān lǐ mílù le, zhǐhǎo shùnzhe héliú wǎng shān xià zǒu.
examples.english: He got lost in the mountains, so he had no choice but to follow the river downstream.

examples.chinese: 元宵節燈會是華人新年的重要活動。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié dēnghuì shì Huárén xīnnián de zhòngyào huódòng.
examples.english: The Lantern Festival Lantern Carnival is an important event for Chinese New Year.

examples.chinese: 最近有什麼好看的電視節目？
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn yǒu shénme hǎokàn de diànshì jiémù?
examples.english: What good TV programs are there recently?

examples.chinese: 這個星期六是元宵節，妳跟友美會去看燈會嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqī liù shì Yuánxiāojié, nǐ gēn Yǒuměi huì qù kàn dēnghuì ma?
examples.english: This Saturday is the Lantern Festival. Will you and Youmei go to see the Lantern Carnival?

examples.chinese: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 每年春節時，爸爸都會送隔壁鄰居一盒蘋果，祝他們每天都平安、如意。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūnjié shí, bàba dōu huì sòng gébì línjū yī hé píngguǒ, zhù tāmen měi tiān dōu píng'ān, rúyì.
examples.english: Every year during Spring Festival, Dad gives the neighbor next door a box of apples, wishing them peace and that everything goes as they wish every day.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 電視上正在播出跨年演唱會，節目非常吸引人，你快來看吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shàng zhèngzài bōchū kuànián yǎnchànghuì, jiémù fēicháng xīyǐn rén, nǐ kuài lái kàn ba.
examples.english: The TV is broadcasting the New Year's Eve concert right now; the program is very attractive, so come watch it quickly.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese: 中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
examples.pinyin: Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.
examples.english: The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

items.wordHook: a 竹(bamboo) flute leans on the 即(prompt) of a doorway → 節(festival).

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 我不認為地攤沒好貨，有一些地攤的東西不僅價格便宜，品質也不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú rènwéi dìtān méi hǎohuò, yǒu yìxiē dìtān de dōngxi bùjǐn jiàgé piányi, pǐnzhì yě búcuò.
examples.english: I don't think street stalls have no good goods; some stall items are not only cheap in price, but the quality is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn méiyǒu dìzhèn, táifēng, érqiě tiānqì hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, shēnghuó huánjìng ānquán yòu shūshì.
examples.english: This area not only has no earthquakes or typhoons, but also has good weather and fresh air; the living environment is safe and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng bùjǐn zhǎng de shuài, chuānzhuó yě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi tā shì míngxīng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Zhāng is not only handsome but also dresses with great taste, so many people think he is a celebrity.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 一般人認為，名牌商品不僅價格高，品質標準也比較高。「先有雞還是先有蛋」，這個問題有標準答案嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yìbān rén rènwéi, míngpái shāngpǐn bùjǐn jiàgé gāo, pǐnzhì biāozhǔn yě bǐjiào gāo. “Xiān yǒu jī háishì xiān yǒu dàn”, zhège wèntí yǒu biāozhǔn dá'àn ma?
examples.english: Most people think that brand-name products are not only high in price, but their quality standard is also relatively high. “Which came first, the chicken or the egg?” Does this question have a standard answer?

examples.chinese: 出國當交換學生的目的，不僅僅是為了學習語言，更重要的是了解當地的文化。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó dāng jiāohuàn xuéshēng de mùdì, bù jǐnjǐn shì wèile xuéxí yǔyán, gèng zhòngyào de shì liǎojiě dāngdì de wénhuà.
examples.english: The purpose of going abroad as an exchange student is not merely to study a language; more importantly, it is to understand the local culture.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.
examples.english: Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer.

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese: 人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
examples.pinyin: Rénkǒu zēngjiā bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng shēnghuó pǐnzhí, kǒngpà yě huì zàochéng shíwù quēfá de wèntí.
examples.english: Population growth not only affects the quality of life, but I am afraid it will also cause the problem of food shortage.

examples.chinese: 那家文具店賣的文具種類很多，像筆、書包、本子等學生用品，不僅品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā wénjù diàn mài de wénjù zhǒnglèi hěn duō, xiàng bǐ, shūbāo, běnzi děng xuésheng yòngpǐn, bùjǐn pǐnzhì hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.
examples.english: The stationery store sells many kinds of stationery, such as pens, backpacks, notebooks, and other student supplies; not only is the quality good, but the price is also not expensive.

examples.chinese: 這道菜是用新鮮蔬果做的，不僅味道甘甜，對健康也有好處。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài shì yòng xīnxiān shūguǒ zuò de, bùjǐn wèidào gāntián, duì jiànkāng yě yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: This dish is made with fresh vegetables and fruits; not only does it taste sweet, but it is also good for your health.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的路規劃得不太理想，不僅沒有一條是直的，方向也有點兒亂，很容易就迷路了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū de lù guīhuà de bú tài lǐxiǎng, bùjǐn méiyǒu yì tiáo shì zhí de, fāngxiàng yě yǒudiǎnr luàn, hěn róngyì jiù mílù le.
examples.english: The roads in this area are not planned very ideally; not only is there not a single straight one, but the directions are also a bit chaotic, so it's easy to get lost.

examples.chinese: 這次長途旅行不僅行程豐富，並且讓我交到了不少朋友、擴大了視野。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì chángtú lǚxíng bùjǐn xíngchéng fēngfù, bìngqiě ràng wǒ jiāo dào le bùshǎo péngyou, kuòdà le shìyě.
examples.english: This long-distance trip not only had a rich itinerary, but also let me make quite a few friends and broadened my horizons.

examples.chinese: 那個病人不知道中了哪一種毒，不僅皮膚變黑，也昏迷好幾天了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge bìngrén bù zhīdào zhòng le nǎ yī zhǒng dú, bùjǐn pífū biàn hēi, yě hūnmí hǎo jǐ tiān le.
examples.english: That patient doesn't know what kind of poison he was poisoned with; not only has his skin turned black, but he has also been in a coma for several days.

examples.chinese: 當外科醫生不容易，不僅要有手術的專業能力，體力也得夠好。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wàikē yīshēng bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào yǒu shǒushù de zhuānyè nénglì, tǐlì yě děi gòu hǎo.
examples.english: Being a surgery doctor is not easy; you not only need professional surgical skills, but your physical strength also has to be good enough.

examples.chinese: 這位外科醫師不僅很會開刀，對病人也很有耐心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wàikē yīshī bùjǐn hěn huì kāidāo, duì bìngrén yě hěn yǒu nàixīn.
examples.english: This surgeon is not only very skilled at performing operations, but also very patient with patients.

examples.chinese: 幸福的婚姻不僅需要觀念的溝通，更需要感情的交流。
examples.pinyin: Xìngfú de hūnyīn bùjǐn xūyào guānniàn de gōutōng, gèng xūyào gǎnqíng de jiāoliú.
examples.english: A happy marriage not only requires communication of ideas but even more requires an exchange of feelings.

examples.chinese: 現代的口紅不僅使用方便，在顏色上也有不少變化。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài de kǒuhóng bùjǐn shǐyòng fāngbiàn, zài yánsè shàng yě yǒu bùshǎo biànhuà.
examples.english: Modern lipstick is not only convenient to use, but also has quite a few variations in color.

examples.chinese: 自動化工廠不僅使生產速度更快，同時也能保證產品品質。
examples.pinyin: Zìdònghuà gōngchǎng bùjǐn shǐ shēngchǎn sùdù gèng kuài, tóngshí yě néng bǎozhèng chǎnpǐn pǐnzhí.
examples.english: Automated factories not only make production speed faster but also can guarantee product quality.

examples.chinese: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
examples.pinyin: Cháoshī de jūzhù huánjìng bùjǐn shǐ jiājù bù róngyì bǎoyǎng, bìngqiě gèng kěnéng shānghài réntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 我不認為地攤沒好貨，有一些地攤的東西不僅價格便宜，品質也不錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bú rènwéi dìtān méi hǎohuò, yǒu yìxiē dìtān de dōngxi bùjǐn jiàgé piányi, pǐnzhì yě búcuò.
examples.english: I don't think street stalls have no good goods; some stall items are not only cheap in price, but the quality is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 黃教授不僅知識豐富、上課認真，還很關心學生，大家都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Huáng jiàoshòu bùjǐn zhīshì fēngfù, shàngkè rènzhēn, hái hěn guānxīn xuéshēng, dàjiā dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: Professor Huang not only has rich knowledge and teaches seriously, but also cares about students very much; everyone respects him greatly.

examples.chinese: 這次的水災不僅淹了整條街，好幾家工廠也因為淹水沒辦法生產，真是太糟了！
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de shuǐzāi bùjǐn yān le zhěng tiáo jiē, hǎo jǐ jiā gōngchǎng yě yīnwèi yānshuǐ méi bànfǎ shēngchǎn, zhēn shì tài zāo le!
examples.english: This flooding not only flooded the entire street, but several factories also couldn't produce because of the flooding—it's really too bad!

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 孔子不僅是中國偉大教師的代表，他的教育和哲學思想，對華人的影響也很大。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ bùjǐn shì Zhōngguó wěidà jiàoshī de dàibiǎo, tā de jiàoyù hé zhéxué sīxiǎng, duì Huárén de yǐngxiàng yě hěn dà.
examples.english: Confucius is not only a representative of China's great teachers, but his educational and philosophical thoughts have also had a great influence on Chinese people.

examples.chinese: 這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn méiyǒu dìzhèn, táifēng, érqiě tiānqì hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, shēnghuó huánjìng ānquán yòu shūshì.
examples.english: This area not only has no earthquakes or typhoons, but also has good weather and fresh air; the living environment is safe and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳的菜不僅平價，還很營養，常常中午十二點前舉客滿了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng de cài bùjǐn píngjià, hái hěn yíngyǎng, chángcháng zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn qián jiù kèmǎn le.
examples.english: This restaurant's dishes are not only affordable but also very nutritious; it is often full before 12 noon.

examples.chinese: 小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng bùjǐn zhǎng de shuài, chuānzhuó yě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi tā shì míngxīng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Zhāng is not only handsome but also dresses with great taste, so many people think he is a celebrity.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 一般人認為，名牌商品不僅價格高，品質標準也比較高。「先有雞還是先有蛋」，這個問題有標準答案嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yìbān rén rènwéi, míngpái shāngpǐn bùjǐn jiàgé gāo, pǐnzhì biāozhǔn yě bǐjiào gāo. “Xiān yǒu jī háishì xiān yǒu dàn”, zhège wèntí yǒu biāozhǔn dá'àn ma?
examples.english: Most people think that brand-name products are not only high in price, but their quality standard is also relatively high. “Which came first, the chicken or the egg?” Does this question have a standard answer?

examples.chinese: 出國當交換學生的目的，不僅僅是為了學習語言，更重要的是了解當地的文化。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó dāng jiāohuàn xuéshēng de mùdì, bù jǐnjǐn shì wèile xuéxí yǔyán, gèng zhòngyào de shì liǎojiě dāngdì de wénhuà.
examples.english: The purpose of going abroad as an exchange student is not merely to study a language; more importantly, it is to understand the local culture.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.
examples.english: Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer.

examples.chinese: 爸爸常教導我做人要謙虛，太驕傲的話，不僅讓人討厭，做事也可能不順利。
examples.pinyin: Bàba cháng jiàodǎo wǒ zuòrén yào qiānxū, tài jiāo'ào de huà, bùjǐn ràng rén tǎoyàn, zuòshì yě kěnéng bù shùnlì.
examples.english: Dad often teaches me to be modest. If you are too arrogant, not only will people dislike you, but things may not go smoothly either.

examples.chinese: 人口增加不僅影響生活品質，恐怕也會造成食物缺乏的問題。
examples.pinyin: Rénkǒu zēngjiā bùjǐn yǐngxiǎng shēnghuó pǐnzhí, kǒngpà yě huì zàochéng shíwù quēfá de wèntí.
examples.english: Population growth not only affects the quality of life, but I am afraid it will also cause the problem of food shortage.

examples.chinese: 那家文具店賣的文具種類很多，像筆、書包、本子等學生用品，不僅品質好，價錢也不貴。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā wénjù diàn mài de wénjù zhǒnglèi hěn duō, xiàng bǐ, shūbāo, běnzi děng xuésheng yòngpǐn, bùjǐn pǐnzhì hǎo, jiàqián yě bù guì.

examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

items.wordHook: Clearly 不(not) possessing 僅(only): 不僅 means not only.

examples.chinese: 按照華人的習俗，紅包裡面的錢不可以是四百、四千等等。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Huárén de xísú, hóngbāo lǐmiàn de qián bù kěyǐ shì sìbǎi, sìqiān děngděng.
examples.english: According to Chinese customs, the money inside a red envelope cannot be 400, 4000, etc.

examples.chinese: 按照商品目錄的說明，消費滿五百元可以打八五折。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào shāngpǐn mùlù de shuōmíng, xiāofèi mǎn wǔbǎi yuán kěyǐ dǎ bāwǔzhé.
examples.english: According to the product catalog, if you spend 500 yuan, you can get a 15% discount.

examples.chinese: 完全按照別人的話來工作，是很省事沒錯，卻失去了讓自己進步的機會。
examples.pinyin: Wánquán ànzhào biérén de huà lái gōngzuò, shì hěn shěngshì méicuò, què shīqù le ràng zìjǐ jìnbù de jīhuì.
examples.english: Working completely according to others' words is indeed very trouble-saving, but it loses the opportunity to let yourself improve.

examples.chinese: 按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Zhōngguó de chuántǒng guānniàn, nǚrén wèi jià shí děi tīng fùqīn de huà, jià le rén zhīhòu jiù děi tīng zhàngfu de.
examples.english: According to traditional Chinese concepts, before a woman marries she must listen to her father's words, and after she marries she must listen to her husband's.

examples.chinese: 按照我國官方規定，民間辦理環保活動可向官方申請經費。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào wǒ guó guānfāng guīdìng, mínjiān bànlǐ huánbǎo huódòng kě xiàng guānfāng shēnqǐng jīngfèi.
examples.english: According to our country's official regulations, when non-governmental organizations hold environmental activities, they can apply to the government for funding.

examples.chinese: 手機鬧鐘的音量及音樂聲，都可按照個人的使用習慣來調整。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī nàozhōng de yīnliàng jí yīnyuè shēng, dōu kě ànzhào gèrén de shǐyòng xíguàn lái tiáozhěng.
examples.english: The volume of the mobile phone alarm and the sound of the music can both be adjusted according to personal usage habits.

items.wordHook: Executing duties 按(based on) rules that 照(shine) light on standard procedure: 按照 means according to.

examples.chinese: 根據本大樓的管理規定，私人物品不可堆在公共區域。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù běn dàlóu de guǎnlǐ guīdìng, sīrén wùpǐn bùkě duī zài gōnggòng qūyù.
examples.english: According to the management rules of this building, personal items may not be piled up in public areas.

examples.chinese: 這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì gōngsī zhǔbàn de, mùdì shì wèile zēngjiā tóngshì zhījiān de gǎnqíng.
examples.english: This event is organized by the company, and the purpose is to increase the bonds among colleagues.

items.wordHook: 便(convenient) + 宜(suitable) → a price convenient and suitable for your wallet: cheap.
A handy item for 凳(bench) with suffix 子(child): 凳子 means stool.
Trained to 攝(absorb) light and capture moving 影(shadow) pictures through an optical 機(machine): 攝影機 means video camera.
The 斬(chop) cuts the 日(sun) short, so its light is only 暫(temporary).
Soothing 氵(water) poured into a warm ceramic 皿(dish) warms cold hands until they feel delightfully 溫(warm).
Combining 畢(finish) and 竟(finally): 畢竟 means after all.
Spreading warm 衤(cloth) over delicate 皮(skin) at night provides cozy 被(bedding).
A 身-shaped figure bends at the waist to lift a heavy sack → 身(body).
